macros.name: beamergotobutton
macros.doc: Draws a button with the given ⟨button text⟩. Before the text, a small symbol (usually a right-pointing arrow) is inserted that indicates that pressing this button will jump to another “area” of the presentation.

macros.name: beameroriginal

macros.name: beamerreturnbutton
macros.doc: The symbol drawn for this button is usually a left-pointing arrow. Use this button if pressing it will return from a detour.

macros.name: beamerskipbutton
macros.doc: The symbol drawn for this button is usually a double right arrow. Use this button if pressing it will skip over a well-defined part of your talk.

macros.name: breakhere
